103)bla ma'i gsol 'debs yid kyi gdung sel bzhugs/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /rten 'byung 'gag med sgyu 'phrul rol

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma'i gsol 'debs yid kyi gdung sel bzhugs// chos dbyings 'gyur med skye 'gag gnas gsum bral// rten 'byung 'gag med sgyu 'phrul rol mor shar// mkha' khyab ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid can// mtshungs med dpal ldan bla mar gsol ba 'debs// pad+ma ka ras rjes bzung mkhyen brtse'i gter// kun bzang theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// bslab gsum nor bu'i mdzod mnga' chos kyi rje// mtshungs med dpal ldan= 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ges byin gyis brlas// grub gnyis yid bzhin gter la dbang 'byor ba'i// mkhyen gnyis blo gros chags thogs bral ba'i thugs// mtshungs med dpal ldan= rmad byung legs bshad sgra dbyangs nyin byed gzi// blo gsal yid kyi pad mor 'khyud pa las// zag med bde chen myu gu bskyed bsrings pa// mtshungs med dpal ldan= thub bstan lung rtogs rgyas pa'i pad tshal du// bshad sgrub chos kyi lus stobs rab rgyas shing*// spobs pa'i gter brgyad grol ba'i glang po che// mtshungs med dpal ldan= phar phyin drug gi ut+pal dri bsung gi /bsdu dngos bzhi yis skal bzang bung ba sdud// zab dang rgya che'i blo gros 104) pha mtha' yas/ mtshungs= rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid spros mtha' bral// mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i ye shes che// zung 'jug lhan skyes bde chen rdo rje'i bdag /mtshungs= mdo sgyu sems gsum dpal chen dkyil 'khor dgu// yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bka' bab rim gnyis kyi// rnal 'byor la brtan rang rig rtsal rdzogs pa// mtshungs= kun bzang thugs bstan 'od gsal rdzogs pa che// theg mchog rgyal po bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin// chos nyid bar med 'od gsal 'byams su klas/ mtshungs med dpal ldan bla= gdod ma'i rang mdangs khyad chos drug ldan dbyings// mkha' klong yangs pa kun bzang dgongs pa brnyes/ khyab brdal gcig chod rdo rje sems dpa' dngos// mtshungs med dpal ldan=

de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma rje'i// gsang gsum dgongs pa'i byin rlabs bdag la 'phos// kun mkhyen bla ma khyod bzhin bdag gyur nas// ma lus 'gro ba'i dpal mgon nyid gyur cig zhes pa'ang mos ldan chos dpal bzang po nas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor ma ldog tsam du rab btags ky-i rgyan lta bur brjod gzhi med pa'i bstod skad thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa brgyud pa gsum gyi bla ma'i byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig dge'o//
